20% profit is distributed among all tokens sold

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker discloses personal participation and says funds were moved from the Hashflare project into the token purchase discussion.

evidence.quote: I already put my funds through hashflare
Naturally, I took profit from Hashflare

visual_context_notes.observation: The project site visibly provides links labeled "ПРОСПЕКТ", "TOKEN WHITEPAPER", "TERMS AND CONDITIONS", "PRIVACY POLICY", "ESCROW ARRANGEMENT", and "BUSINESS MODEL".
A project page identifies the token issuer as "Polybius Foundation OU" and displays an EU flag graphic alongside the issuer information.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes entry into a Polybius token offering, directs viewers to a link, and shows an interface for investing BTC. It promises immediate resale profit, dividends, and a bonus turning a $40 contribution into $50, while presenting the project as regulated despite describing its banking license as a future event.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is participation in the Polybius token sale, with the speaker describing both potential resale profit and dividends for holders. Hashflare's paid mining contracts are a separately evidenced, less central offer.

evidence.observation: The speaker says they participated in the token purchase.
evidence.quote: I bought tokens.

evidence.observation: The speaker presents resale profit and dividends as possible outcomes of holding the tokens.
evidence.quote: you can sell on the market to get momentary profit, and you just save the tokens and receive dividends

evidence.observation: The Polybius page displays options to sell tokens after the ICO for a potential profit or keep tokens for dividends.
The Hashflare page displays priced cloud-mining contracts, buy-now buttons and text indicating automatic accrual in cryptocurrency.
While discussing Hashflare, the speaker characterizes its contracts in terms of profitability.
evidence.quote: the most profitable are the indefinite contracts.

evidence.observation: The Polybius wallet displays bonus percentages organized by day or week of the token sale.
